title: Amenophis
summary: Raleigh names Amenophis in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Amenophis, placed next before Busiris by some, and after Ramesses by others. Kept apart from the Cory eighteenth-dynasty kings of the same name. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Book II, Part I, Chapter II, §. VIII, sig. 172b–173a
reign.note: Body intake. A reign length or duration. Not a yeere of the World. year_am stays null. This does not change the sort.

free_source_links.locator: Contents, Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVI, sig. 33a
